WalesAB.title: Wales beat the All Blacks: 73 years in numbers
WalesAB.desc:
Wales 35, New Zealand 28, Principality Stadium, 14 November 2026.

Five tries to four. Wales' previous win over New Zealand: 1953, 73 years ago.
Same stadium a year ago: Wales lost 26-52. This time they won 35-28, a 33-point swing in 12 months.
In the final quarter the All Blacks were held up over the Welsh line three times.

Figures only, from match reports (1News, ESPN). No opinion on any decision.
